title: eleocharis indica
intro: Eleocharis indica, commonly known as the Indian Spike Rush, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the sedge family. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Eleocharis indica include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which help in reducing fever, relieving digestive issues, and treating skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
